result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out. The main visible defect is a vertical misalignment in the 'Fastest near you' carousel: the Smash Bros Burgers card sits about 28px lower than the Green Bowl Poké card, so their images, time badges, and titles don't line up. The clipped carousel item and the cut-off card at the bottom are intentional scroll affordances and are not reported.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Smash Bros Burgers card is vertically offset from the Green Bowl Poké card. Its image starts about 27px lower, and its title and delivery fee sit about 28px lower, so the row looks uneven.
issues.suggestion: Align the carousel cards to the top edge with consistent image heights and a shared top margin, so each image, title, and delivery fee sits on the same baseline.
